finalText:
I've rebooked all 13 reservations from the cancelled AA918, issued the vouchers they were owed and sent each passenger one message. No bulletins were in effect, so the handbook rules applied unchanged. The original flight was due into Chicago O'Hare (ORD) at 13:40 on 3 Aug, and Dev's and Mo's AA1402 connection was due into Boston at 18:55. Every move went through with no change fee or fare difference, and AA918's passenger list is now empty.

I seated people in priority order: tier (platinum, gold, silver, none), then earliest booking date. Each got the soonest-arriving seat in their own cabin.

| Reservation | Passenger (tier, cabin paid) | New flights | Arrives | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R6103 | Chloe Park (platinum, business) | UA88, 3 Aug, 06:15 | ORD 12:25, 3 Aug | none (early) |
| R6109 | Iris Vance (platinum, economy) | UA88, 3 Aug, **moved up to premium economy** | ORD 12:25, 3 Aug | none |
| R6110 + R6111 | Jun Takeda + Kofi Mensah (travelling together; ranked gold via Kofi), economy | AA204, 3 Aug, 09:05, kept together | ORD 15:15, 3 Aug | none (1h35 late) |
| R6102 | Ben Okafor (gold, economy) | DL512, 3 Aug, 12:30 | ORD 18:40, 3 Aug | $150 (5h late) |
| R6106 | Farid Haddad (gold, basic economy) | UA88, 3 Aug | ORD 12:25, 3 Aug | none |
| R6112 | Lea Sorensen (gold, premium economy) | AA204, 3 Aug, **moved up to business** | ORD 15:15, 3 Aug | none |
| R6104 | Dev Mehta (silver, economy, to Boston) | AA210, 3 Aug, 17:40, then AA1410, 4 Aug, 09:00 | BOS 12:25, 4 Aug | $300 + $180 hotel |
| R6113 | Mo Farah (silver, economy, to Boston) | AA210, 3 Aug, 17:40, then AA1410, 4 Aug, 09:00 | BOS 12:25, 4 Aug | $300 + $180 hotel |
| R6108 | Hugo Brandt (silver, economy) | AA210, 3 Aug, 17:40 | ORD 23:50, 3 Aug | $300 (10h10 late) |
| R6107 | Grace Liu (no tier, economy) | AA206, 4 Aug, 09:05 | ORD 15:15, 4 Aug | $240 (capped at her fare) + $180 hotel |
| R6101 | Ana Ruiz (no tier, economy) | AA206, 4 Aug, 09:05 | ORD 15:15, 4 Aug | $300 + $180 hotel |
| R6105 | Elena Fox (no tier, basic economy) | AA204, 3 Aug, 09:05 | ORD 15:15, 3 Aug | none |

- **Why only two people moved up a cabin:** Iris and Lea are the only two who meet the rule: gold or platinum, travelling alone on a single flight, with their own cabin full on a flight that lands sooner than anything still open in that cabin. Ben, also gold, couldn't be moved up. Iris had already taken the last premium economy seat on UA88, and AA204 had none.
- **Boston connections:** the new first leg broke Dev's and Mo's AA1402 connection, so I rebooked their onward leg as well. That leaves them overnight at O'Hare with a valid next-morning connection. No Boston flight on 3 Aug could be reached in time, and there are no direct San Francisco–Boston flights.
- **Voucher records:** I issued 10 vouchers (V1–V10), each as its own record. A search of today's ledger returns no entries, so the vouchers apparently aren't logged as ledger entries. I confirmed each one from the voucher tool's own response instead.

All 13 messages (N1–N13) were delivered. Each gives the new flights and cabin, says the change was free, and lists any vouchers or explains why none apply. I didn't touch any other bookings or queue requests.

One oddity: the flight date (3 Aug 2026) is before today (6 Oct 2026). I went ahead as instructed, since the system accepted every rebooking.
